messages:
sam: planning a cautious v2 split in tomorrow's 09:00 UTC window. initial 10% EU-only for 15m, then evaluate. need quick rollback triggers and pinlist additions.

lee: note — older clients ignore new `schema_strict` flag. recommend gateway fallback for 24h and add known-issue to release notes.

ops_anna: alert thresholds: 5xx > 0.5% for 2m OR p95 > 750ms -> rollback. also tenant quarantine: tenant error > 1% -> pin tenant to v1.

dev_ben: gateway fallback (case: lenient schema) is ready. faster than changing v2 runtime. will enable during toggle.

deploybot: scheduled by sam at 2025-06-10T09:00:00Z. action id r-1733333333. will route EU 10% to v2 and apply gateway fallback.

sam: rollback CLI for ops if thresholds hit:
```
deploybot rollback --route /api --from v2 --to v1 --id r-1733333333 --reason "auto-threshold"
```

ops_anna: wiring alerts to @eng-oncall and runbook link added. will auto-execute CLI if configured thresholds breach after a 30s confirmation.

deploybot: toggle started at 2025-06-10T09:00:00Z -> EU 10% to v2 (r-1733333333). gateway fallback enabled.

ops_anna: first 5m: p50 90ms, p95 170ms, 5xx 0.01% — healthy.

lee: mobile alpha showed a small stream truncation in 0.007% of requests. logging samples to s3://rollouts/r-1733333333/samples. recommending hold until next SDK alpha.

sam: decision: hold at 10% for the full 15m; do not expand until mobile alpha cleared. update release notes and add mobile alpha to pinlist.

deploybot: status: partial (10%) route active. will execute tenant quarantine and rollback as configured. final status at 2025-06-10T09:02:30Z.

sam: thanks — leaving thread open for updates. if rollback happens, ping #eng-oncall and post the CLI command above.
